title: Object normalizations of the recorded common-stage operations
statement: Let ℓ be prime and Ω an algebraic closure of Q_ℓ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the common-stage constructible pair categories over schemes [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and the recorded common-stage derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For every morphism g : X → Y with ℓ invertible on X and Y [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and every common-stage object P on Y, the object of the chosen pullback functor at P equals commonStagePullbackObject(g,P). For every scheme W with ℓ invertible and every pair M,N of common-stage objects, the chosen tensor functor at (M,N) has object commonStageTensorObject(W,M,N). For every scheme W and every permitted common-stage Hom pair P, the chosen internal-Hom functor has object commonStageHomObject(W,P). These are literal equalities of pair objects, retaining their coefficient field and representative, not merely isomorphisms.

source.place: Step 5, canonical common-stage operations; the object clauses of commonStageDerivedPullback_existsUnique, commonStageDerivedTensor_existsUnique and commonStageDerivedInternalHom_existsUnique in lean/Sheaf/Paper/DerivedPullbackTensorHom.lean.

proof.text: Each of the three recorded functors is defined by choosing the unique functor with its stated object and representative-arrow normalization. Project the object clause of the specification of that choice. Apply the pullback clause to g and P, the tensor clause to W,M,N, and the Hom clause to the permitted pair P. Conjoin the three universally quantified formulas. The argument does not choose a new object or a new arrow.

lean.statement:
theorem podCommonStageObjectNormalizations :
    (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
      [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
      [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
      (P : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y),
      (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω g).obj P = commonStagePullbackObject l Ω g P) ∧
    (∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
      (M N : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω W),
      (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω W).obj (M, N) = commonStageTensorObject l Ω W M N) ∧
    (∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) (P : (commonStageHomPairs l Ω W).FullSubcategory),
      (commonStageDerivedInternalHom l Ω W).obj P = commonStageHomObject l Ω W P)
